description: Show the user's OWN creator roster — the creators they've already added to their CreatorScore account (the same list as the brand dashboard). Use this when the user asks to 'see/show/list my creators', 'my roster', 'who am I tracking', or wants an overview of who they've vetted. FREE and read-only: it returns cached data only — no scraping, no scoring, no credits charged. Each entry is a whole cross-platform FOOTPRINT (one creator = one row, even across several platforms) with its unified CreatorScore and the titles of any active risk flags. Use limit/offset to page through a large roster.
name: list_roster
